change_log.value: Strict Pydantic Validation and Error Handling
change_log.note: Adds explicit validation failure handling path
Formalizes allowlist as explicit registry construct

stories.title: Strict Pydantic Validation and Error Handling
stories.description: Implement strict validation handling in the tool router such that any schema validation failure produces a deterministic, safe error response without invoking downstream services, including clear error typing for logging and user-safe messaging.

stories.title: Tool Registry and Allowlist Configuration
stories.description: Define a centralized tool registry within the tool_router that explicitly maps allowed tool names to handlers and schemas, preventing implicit or dynamic tool resolution and ensuring maintainable allowlist governance.

stories.title: Cross-Tool Response Normalization Layer
stories.description: Introduce a normalization layer in the tool router that standardizes tool outputs into a consistent structure before returning to the LLM, ensuring predictable downstream handling regardless of tool source.
